column1: # Spec 142 section 5.1: the package manifest of the pc box class. One row per
# package or binary the fleet installs on a pc box: who installs it and who
# needs it. do_box_pkg_drift reads it; base-pc.txt holds the image's own set.
# Columns, TAB separated, sorted by kind then name (LC_ALL=C):
#   kind          apt deb bin pip npm go corepack image
#   name          apt/deb: the package; bin: the bare name, or the path when
#                 it lives outside /usr/local/bin and the agent user's bin dir
#   pin           empty, or the version/sha256 the installer pins
#   installed_by  play <role> (060-gcp-vm-satellite/roles), a do_* action, or
#                 backfill (installed by hand before the install action existed)
#   needed_by     an action, a test or lane SPL-n; never empty
#   service       empty, or dns network init firewall ssh
